newsitem.title: USA: Circon restates opposition to Surgical bid.
newsitem.headline: Circon restates opposition to Surgical bid.

text.p: Circon Corp on Wednesday reiterated its position against a second extension of a tender offer from U.S. Surgical Corp.

"We continue to urge our shareholders not to tender and to urge those who have tendered to withdraw," company Chairman Richard Auhll said. "We do not believe shareholders will realize the true value of their Circon investment if they sell their stock to U. S. Surgical in this tender offer."
Auhll stated that the company will stay focused on its merger with Cabot Medical.
